- Under taskpolicy -b while step 2 runs: 1.2 to 5.7 s per replay. A one-call batch made 5 replays in a 44 s worker run.
- One unthrottled emit with two custody derivations: 0.9 s.

HEADLINE11 means about 11 replays per poll. There is no refusal and no physics effect, only CPU overhead beside the science runs. The design predates this chain; the cost becomes reachable now that R1 is fixed.
